bio.text: Jim Justice is the U.S. Senator from West Virginia; he announced his Senate run in spring 2023 and previously served as Governor of West Virginia, winning election in 2016 and re-election in 2020.
He became President and CEO of Bluestone Industries and Bluestone Coal Corporation, the family business.
He was born April 27, 1951, earned a B.A. and an MBA at Marshall University, and lives in Lewisburg, West Virginia.
